digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime management
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, enabling unintended scope writes and credential leakage to unrelated siblings
Jira Cloud scope contains four implicit `DIG` fallbacks that allow requests to target an unintended project when scope is not explicitly configured
Child process environments inherit full parent state without isolation, so owning adapters' secrets are visible to unrelated sibling processes
Global `os.environ` can be mutated during reconciliation, potentially persisting state across concurrent operations or affecting subsequent requests
A pure child environment projection API is required to selectively inherit ambient variables, overlay adapter-specific material, and exclude other adapters' declared secret names
